hotel_1star_proxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Rome? Hotel Prices for Rome, Italy | Budget Your Trip
hotel_1star_proxy.evidenceText: The exact-city search result reports $137 as the average price of 2,061 1-star hotels in Rome and a $122 median; it describes a one-night stay. The same result states that hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes and that the star-price table is before taxes and fees.
hotel_1star_proxy.referencePeriod: Search result crawled 4 days ago; snippet retrieved 2026-08-01.
hotel_1star_proxy.searchQuery: site:budgetyourtrip.com/hotels Rome Italy 1-star hotel average price one night before taxes
hotel_1star_proxy.reason: Source-defined snippet proxy candidate only: exact city/class, numeric one-night USD average, and explicit pre-tax basis are present; not an observed two-adult product value.

double_occupancy_semantics.sourceTitle: Rome Travel Cost - Average Price of a Vacation to Rome: Food & Meal Budget, Daily & Weekly Expenses | BudgetYourTrip.com
double_occupancy_semantics.evidenceText: The exact-city same-source search result states: the average price paid in Rome for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $206 (€180). It also states that one person sharing averages $103 (€90) per night and that costs are from reported traveler spending.
double_occupancy_semantics.occupancyEvidence: The average price paid in Rome for two people for a typical double-occupancy hotel room is $206 (€180).
